testo: Hi! Today I'm taking the floor, I'm Eva! When Max and Leo were designing the loading system, I made one thing crystal clear: in the kitchen, we don't just buy boxes with barcodes! What about apples from the greengrocer? Fresh cheese from the market? That's why we created fresh produce management without barcodes: add foods in seconds with their real expiration date, and the app will alert you before veggies spoil at the back of the fridge!
